By way of response, may we advise you to call first the attention of the municipal treasurer on the matter and discuss it w'th him. Should this fail, you may rather refer the matter to your municipal mayor pursuant to Section 444 (b) (1) (x) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA.7160) wherein it is the duty of the Municipal Mayor to ensure that employees pf the municipality faithfully discharge their duties and functions as provided by INW and this Code.
